newsitem.title: DUBAI: Yemen gets new $19.9 mln loan from Arab fund.
newsitem.headline: Yemen gets new $19.9 mln loan from Arab fund.

text.p: Yemen on Tuesday signed a six million Kuwaiti dinar ($19.9 million) loan accord with the Kuwait-based Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development, Gulf news agencies reported.
They said the loan will go to a 17 million dinar Yemeni social development fund which will finance new projects to help poor families in the impoverished Arab state.

Earlier on Tuesday Yemen's state television announced the completion of a $64 million project linking the power grids of the former north and south Yemen. The Arab Fund had extended the project a $54 million loan.
